manual_notes: Substantial DOCX generation is implemented: deterministic compile pipeline, validation, styles, sections, headers/footers, tables, numbering, field runs and optional drafting comments, with targeted structural tests. A later pinned compatibility checklist records Word/Pages/Google observations, so archive timing alone is not the limitation. However, SDX-GEN-082 requires no comment parts after post-generation note deletion: deleteComment writes empty comment parts back and toBuffer retains them. The associated test permits an empty comments part instead of enforcing absence. This concrete full-scope mismatch prevents a strict completed label; no abandonment inferred.
